name: turso-scaler-sqlite
about: Turso (libSQL, SQLite dialect) on the Scaler plan at its overage prices, allowance 0 (C10). libSQL bills rows read and rows written, so the candidate's own row meters are priced with no store shape; the storage-supplies conformance run passed all 13 record store cases on libSQL server (sqld), the same wire Turso serves. Prices are read by meter name from the dated price sheet (root price_sheets: turso-scaler.json, as of 2026-10-28, official page). Scaler is the plan a hosted service sits on; Developer overage is $1.00 per million rows written and $0.75 per GB-month, Pro $0.75 and $0.45.

prices.basis: Turso bills rows read. SQLite loop visits are the local proxy, as for the Durable Object model (CAL-5).
Assumed: an index entry written counts as a row written, as on D1 and Durable Objects; the Turso page does not say.

latency.basis: AI assumption copied from the Durable Object model; used only when a run simulates queueing at this placement, never by the usage table, which prices saved meters.

unpriced.item: Scaler $24.92 per month and its included rows and storage
unpriced.why: one per Turso organization, shared by every customer of the hosted service, so not a per-team charge
Turso has no object store; sealed history generations would go to a separate object store priced in its own sheet
Turso has no alarms; the scheduler that wakes due items runs elsewhere; the rows each wake reads and writes are priced
priced in the sheet ($0.25 per GB synced) but the simulation does not model replica sync
